data.one_liner: Widgets for lazy-loading lists and grids with pagination support.
data.what_it_does: Provides ListView, GridView, SliverList and SliverGrid widgets that load data page‑by‑page. Allows custom loading, error, empty and retry UI and optional external PagewiseLoadController for finer control.
use_when: Displaying large or unbounded data sets with infinite scroll
Needing built‑in pagination without writing custom scroll logic
avoid_when: Static small lists where pagination adds overhead
When you need a full data‑layer solution with caching or state management
weaknesses: Only handles pagination, no caching or data management
Requires you to supply pageFuture logic
